caption: Sweet potato mac & cheese 🤍 A creamy, comforting meal made with simple ingredients. Ingredients: • 1 cup pasta • 1 cup mashed sweet potato • ½ cup cheddar cheese • ¼ cup heavy cream or milk • 1 tbsp olive oil Instructions: Cook pasta and drain. Add mashed sweet potato, cheddar, and olive oil. Stir until cheese starts to melt. Add cream or milk. Heat on low and stir until smooth and creamy. Let cool slightly before serving.
